text: たたかう　げんきも　ないや　とりに　のって　うちに　かえろう

structure.jp: たたかう　げんきも　ないや
structure.en: I don't even have the energy to battle

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right in front of a thing tells you what kind of thing it is. たたかう　げんき = 'the energy to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending on a verb means 'let's' or 'I think I'll'. かえろう = 'I'll go home'.

patterns.name: 〜や (sentence ending)
patterns.explanation: や at the end of a sentence is a casual sigh to yourself, like 'oh well'. ないや = 'I just don't have any'.
